The angle between two planes is the same as the angle between their normal vectors. To find the cosine of the angle $\theta$ between two normal vectors $\mathbf{n_1}$ and $\mathbf{n_2}$, you use the dot product formula:

$$\cos \theta = \frac{|\mathbf{n_1} \cdot \mathbf{n_2}|}{\left\| \mathbf{n_1} \right\| \left\| \mathbf{n_2} \right\|}$$

You will need to calculate the dot product for the numerator and the product of the magnitudes of the two vectors for the denominator.
